entities.name: ERCC1
observations: The 298-residue query is 89.9% identical to reviewed human ERCC1 (UniProt P07992) with 99.7% query coverage and E-value 2.55e-189.
ERCC1 is a non-catalytic component of a structure-specific DNA repair endonuclease; the catalytic nuclease partner is ERCC4/XPF.
ERCC1 forms a heterodimer with ERCC4/XPF and contributes to 5-prime incision during DNA repair, interstrand cross-link repair, anaphase-bridge processing, and homology-directed repair.
Curated localization evidence places ERCC1 in the nucleus/nucleoplasm, with some evidence also supporting cytoplasmic presence.
The sequence contains a Rad10 domain at residues 99-219 and HHH/HHH_5 helix-hairpin-helix regions near residues 239-287.
No explicit catalytic reaction was retrieved; sequence and curated annotations support a structural/scaffolding DNA-repair role rather than independent nuclease catalysis.
The query is approximately neutral-to-acidic by computed properties: 32.8 kDa and theoretical pI 6.01; these are sequence-derived estimates.

entities.name: ERCC4/XPF
observations: ERCC4/XPF is the nuclease partner that heterodimerizes with ERCC1 in the structure-specific DNA repair endonuclease complex.

entities.name: DNA repair
observations: ERCC1 participates in repair of damaged DNA, interstrand cross-links, selected double-strand-break intermediates, and recombination-associated structures through complexes with ERCC4/XPF and SLX4.

entities.name: Nucleus
observations: Reviewed ERCC1 annotations place the protein in the nucleus and nucleoplasm; cytoplasmic localization is also reported in some contexts.
